notes.title: Take on the Boss Challenge Pack, available August 15!
notes.content:
The bosses that blocked your way in the Story Mode are stronger than ever in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1616110]Glitch Busters: Stuck on You[/url]! Show off your magnet and shooting skills by challenging the most difficult mode in the game's history solo or with your friends.

Take your Glitchless fashion to the next level with new demonic accessories, adorable faces, monotone suits and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317316/1244b27d3c8a973f115c7b1bb8c8fc1dabdd556b.jpg[/img]

This new endgame "Challenge Mode" pits you and up to 3 others against six bosses one after another--and of course comes with new customization parts, 15 in total.

[list]
[*] "Challenge Mode" bosses and enemies to challenge your Glitchbusting prowess
[*] 15 new customization options for your fabulous Glitchless wardrobe
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080650

notes.title: Version 1.03 Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello Glitch Busters,

Check out patch notes for the latest update!

[list]
[*] If the host turns off session open, friends cannot be invited and the party will break up.
[*] If a player exits the game at the moment the player falls into a swamp or lava, the player character does not switch to AI control.
[*] Dialogue in cutscenes occasionally does not appear when playing in split-screen mode.
[*] Frame rate occasionally drops during cutscenes in the base.
[*] The color of the player character's weapon in cutscenes is sometimes incorrect.
[*] Staff roll is not displayed correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.02 Update Notes
notes.content:
● Fixed a bug that caused a crash when a client accepted an invitation to a session while the host had created a session and session open was turned off (This bug only occurs on Steam).
● Fixed a bug where SteamVR would start when the game was launched if SteamVR was installed, and quitting SteamVR would also quit the game (This bug only occurs on Steam).
● Fixed a bug that caused a rare crash when delivering cardboard in the tutorial.
● Fixed a bug that prevented the host from progressing through the game if the client repeatedly entered and exited the session and then unlocked "The Shadow Causing Chaos Online".
● Fixed a bug that could cause the client's display to be disrupted when cutscenes were played in succession.

notes.title: Join the Glitch Busters: Stuck On You Beta Playtest!
notes.content:
Attention all Glitch Busters!

We're happy to announce that we've partnered with Alienware Arena in a Beta Playtest starting May 2nd at 6am PDT until May 14th.  Simply visit the Alienware link below to grab your beta key and starting playing as soon as tomorrow!

[url=https://na.alienwarearena.com/ucf/show/2168013/boards/contest-and-giveaways-global/Giveaway/glitch-busters-stuck-on-you-closed-beta-giveaway]Go here to join the beta![/url]

There is no limit for how many can join and would love any feedback from our community in our forums.  

See below for a couple things to keep in mind for this play test:

[list]
[*]How many levels will be featured in this beta?
This playtest will feature the tutorial as well as 3 additional stages in the story mode taken from Tube City and the Social Forest biomes.

[*] Will there be online play included?
Yes!  In fact, we'd love for you test our network play.  Random matchmaking or playing with people on your Friends list will be supported.

[*] What kind of controls can I use?
You can play with a game controller like a XBOX or PS5 controller or use mouse/keyboard as well.  For specific keyboard controls, see here:

[list]
[*] Move Forward: W
[*] Move Backward: S
[*] Move Left: A
[*] Move Right: D
[*] Jump: Space Bar
[*] Magnet-Dash: Left Shift
[*] Reset Camera: Left Ctrl
[*] Shoot: Left Mouse Button
[*] Reload: R
[*] BJG: Right Mouse Button
[*] Action: F
[*] Gather Here Emote: E
[*] Back Off Emote: Q
[*] Nice Job Emote: V
[*] Pin: Middle Mouse Button
[*] Switch Character (Single player): C
[/list]

[*] Where can I give feedback?
You can go to our discussion board [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1616110/discussions/]here [/url]or to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/skyboundgames]Discord here[/url] in the Glitch Busters channel.

[/list]

Thanks and looking forward to everyone's feedback!

notes.title: PAX West and Tokyo Game Show Wrap-up!
notes.content:
First, as always, be sure to follow and talk with us in the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1616110/discussions/0/?snr=2_9_100015_] Steam Forums[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/GlitchBustGame]Twitter[/url], or on [url=https://discord.com/channels/715340495424978985/969293606047346729]Discord [/url]to get up to date on the latest and greatest with Glitch Busters: Stuck On You. 

With that said, Toylogic and Skybound Games had a chance to bring the digital world of Glitch Busters to IRL at PAX West in Seattle, WA and the Tokyo Game Show in Japan!  

Before we jump into the events themselves, please check out the latest "Worlds of Glitch Busters" trailer which showcases all the different biomes and environments you'll be cleaning up with your 3 other friends. 


[previewyoutube=-V1ss3GQISQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]PAX West 2022[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317316/8ae3e5b44a5d130b5d7d39d65a71bab26d787e12.jpg[/img]
Thank you to everyone who came by the Skybound Games booth on the expo show floor, where we showcased the first public hands-on with Glitch Busters: Stuck On You.  Casey Adams and Nishii-san from Toylogic were on hand to personally walk show goers through the 4-player co-op chaos and magnetic mayhem the game has to offer.

We were overwhelmed by the response from feedback surveys and in person, we’re blown away how positively everyone reacted and how much fun they had with Glitch Busters: Stuck On You.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317316/a4f03788d6cf417f8b5c8f7984f3726e19d21e38.jpg[/img]
We also gave away special PAX exclusive pins but if you want some for yourself, please keep on an eye on our socials and forums for more opportunities in the future to get this swag for yourself!  


[h2]Tokyo Game Show 2022[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317316/cd2544f0e644cc1372c2a98f6a4c66565f8ea487.jpg[/img]
Just a few weeks later, Glitch Busters: Stuck On You came to Toylogic's hometown of Tokyo, Japan at the Tokyo Game Show.   Over 130,000+ attendees came by to check out the game and take pics with the developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317316/62eb3d73b39f0939880aac59aab075bc85b884f5.jpg[/img]
We also had a crew of cosplayers help give out Glitch Busters tote bags and snap a pic on the show floor!  We're so grateful for all the press and fans who came and stopped by to play with us.  Again, the reception was overwhelming positive. 


[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
As we catch our breath from a very busy month, we're looking to get Glitch Busters: Stuck On You to more folks in the very near future through Steam playtests and future beta programs.

If you're interested, please ping one of the moderators on our forums for more information or wait for a future post where we'll announce upcoming plans very soon.   

And one last time, be sure to follow and talk with us in the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1616110/discussions/0/?snr=2_9_100015_] Steam Forums[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/GlitchBustGame]Twitter[/url], or on [url=https://discord.com/channels/715340495424978985/969293606047346729]Discord [/url]to get up to date on the latest and greatest with Glitch Busters: Stuck On You.
